description_en: Configures location blacklist settings for an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance area
description_zh: 设置针对DDoS高防实例的区域封禁
name: ConfigNetworkRegionBlock

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The configuration of the location blacklist, expressed as a JSON string with the following structure:
RegionBlockSwitch: String type. Required. The switch status of the location blacklist. Valid values:
    - on: enabled
    - off: disabled
Countries: Array type. Optional. The list of international region codes to block.
    > For more information about international region codes, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html.


Provinces: Array type. Optional. The list of China region codes to block.

    > For more information about China region codes, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html.

    For example, `[11,12]` indicates Beijing and Tianjin
parameters.help_zh:
区域封禁的配置信息，使用JSON格式的字符串表述，具体结构如下。
RegionBlockSwitch：String类型，必选，区域封禁的开关状态。取值：
    - on：开启
    - off：关闭
Countries：Array类型，可选，要封禁的国际地域代码列表。
    > 关于国际地域代码的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html。
。

Provinces：Array类型，可选，要封禁的中国地域代码列表。

    > 关于中国地域代码的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html。

    例如，`[11,12]`表示北京市和天津市
parameters.name: config
